name: Keelkip
silhouette: A seal-like companion with round muzzle, bright eyes, broad front flippers, forked hind flipper and three overlapping translucent body plates.
motion: Lifts its chest into a flipper-waddle, then settles into a buoyant sliding turn.

name: Wakecradle
silhouette: A broad seal-like animal with long outward-curving flippers and a raised back crest framing a suspended water sling beneath its continuous body.
motion: Banks on one flipper, swings the water sling around a visible corner and lands with a curious head tilt.

name: Cairncricket
silhouette: A cricket-like animal with three offset stone plates, bright eyes beneath a pebble brow, flexible antennae, short forefeet and long jointed hind legs.
motion: Crouches, springs and lands with antenna recoil; the upper stone plate tilts like a living brow.

name: Archspring
silhouette: A high-arched stone cricket with paired long hind legs, a hanging tail stone and large negative spaces between its expressive body and legs.
motion: Leans its face into a deliberate springing gait, then settles a protective counterweight ahead.

name: Rivetfoil
silhouette: A small folded bird with fan-shaped metal wings, a bright eye, pointed beak, forked feet, short balancing tail and one off-center rivet mark.
motion: Tilts its head, side-steps, and flicks one wing to turn an approaching shot into a visible side lane.

name: Gimbalcloak
silhouette: A crested long-necked metal bird whose broad cloak wings surround a gimbal-shaped breast; its face stays visible above the mechanism.
motion: Steps sideways, spreads a directional wing screen, then tucks its wings with a living recovery pose.

name: Skimkip
silhouette: Flying-fish-like animal with cheek spots, short beakless mouth, broad paired fins and forked tail.
motion: Skims low, plants its fins, aims its cheek-lit face and snaps its tail before the cast.

name: Sailskip
silhouette: Long-bodied fish animal with tall connected sail fins framing a strong V-shaped negative space.
motion: Banks through a longer arc; lifts its sail fins, breathes and folds them into a low landing.
role: Single-shot splitting line with endpoint burst

name: Warmcroak
silhouette: Squat round frog with heavy eyelids, short webbed feet and one pale warm throat pouch.
motion: Blinks slowly, takes a deliberate hop and swells its throat before a soft exhale.

name: Bellowswell
silhouette: Broad-stance frog with paired connected cheek and throat folds below an expressive heavy-lidded head.
motion: Rears above wide hind feet, opens its folds for a two-beat exhale, then settles and blinks.

name: Shellwaddle
silhouette: Sideways sand crab with two unequal soft-tipped claws, tracking stalk eyes and a low shell arch.
motion: Eyes follow the player as it sidles; braces one flank, swipes and releases its stance.

name: Vaultback
silhouette: Long-legged crab with a high open shell vault above a visible abdomen and broad under-body gap.
motion: Broad sideways strut; chooses a side, raises the rear legs, intercepts and lowers the vault.

name: Clipmantis
silhouette: Upright thin mantis with triangular expressive head, large aimed eyes, long forearms and four fine walking legs.
motion: Measures a short stalk, aims both eyes, opens its forearms and closes a clear startup arc.

name: Foilscythe
silhouette: Tall mantis with broad crescent forearm foils, long folded abdomen and subordinate close-held wings.
motion: Measured high-knee stalk; unfolds facing foils, watches the crossing and closes them slowly.

name: Swaylemur
silhouette: Long-tailed tree mammal with round forward eyes, plain large ears, small hands and two leaf-like tail tufts.
motion: Sways its tail while watching a route; plants a small decoy, leans aside and gathers its hands.

name: Canopetail
silhouette: Tall long-forearmed tree mammal suspended below a raised tail loop with broad separated leaf tufts.
motion: Counterbalanced steps; reaches toward two endpoints, raises its tail loop and recoils after activation.

name: Rillnewt
silhouette: Low newt with a broad smiling mouth, four widely planted toes and a long flat tail.
motion: Swaying knuckle crawl; lifts its smiling face, splays toes and sweeps a small fork with its tail.

name: Veilcrest
silhouette: Lifted-elbow newt with a transparent continuous dorsal veil and broad foreleg frills.
motion: Raises its elbows and veil; turns its head through a crescent, then lowers the frills.

name: Glimmerbat
silhouette: Fruit-bat-like mammal with large ears, short bright muzzle, connected wing fingers and tucked tail.
motion: Quick flap-hang pauses; ears aim at a target, muzzle brightens and wings fold after marking.

name: Flarefan
silhouette: Broad-winged bat with fingers fanning into a shallow W silhouette above long landing toes.
motion: Lands on long hind toes, fans linked wing fingers toward two marks and slowly folds its wings.

name: Needletrot
silhouette: Long-snouted tenrec-like mammal with focused small eyes, rounded ears, short legs and low quill crest.
motion: Quick nosing trot; aims its snout, banks one spine and shakes the crest into place.

name: Quillstride
silhouette: Slim living quilled mammal with long rear legs and an open fan of separately readable metallic spines.
motion: Rises onto its rear legs, pivots an open quill fan, recalls it and settles its changed center of gravity.

name: Screepeek
silhouette: A stocky tapir with a short mobile trunk, small round ears, heavy hindquarters and three pale pebble pads along its shoulder.
motion: Slow alternating four-foot stroll; trunk probes ahead on the idle beat.

name: Stairtrunk
silhouette: A long-trunked tapir with stepped flaring ears, high shoulders and low hindquarters, leaving a clear diagonal back silhouette.
motion: Forefoot reach, trunk curl, broad rear step; ears fold on recovery.
